## Featured

### [AMMPER](https://github.com/nasa/AMMPER)

Agent-based model of microbial cell populations exposed to ionizing deep-space radiation, developed in the NASA Ames Space Biosciences Division and validated against BioSentinel mission data. Later extended with gamma-radiation and metabolic-dye dynamics and a 3D free-radical diffusion model.

[Code](https://github.com/nasa/AMMPER) · [Fork](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/AMMPER)

### [Texas Children's Hospital Mentor Matching](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/tch-mentormatching) *(private)*

Retrieval-augmented generation system that matches a mentee with Texas Children's Hospital mentors from a CV or an interest description. Private fork; available on request.

[Code](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/tch-mentormatching)

### [OverlapPlots](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/OverlapPlots) *(fork)*

R package for analyzing gene expression variations in neurological diseases, particularly synaptic dysfunction.

[Code](https://github.com/DanPalBCM/OverlapPlots)
